value.rationale: The Chvátal graph is the smallest triangle-free four-chromatic four-regular graph; its adjacent third cut is a known 2-torsion Moore space. The fourth cut is a motivated natural next cutoff, and its exact torsion-free mixed-dimensional integral homology (two rank-eight groups) demonstrates a substantive topological transition while retaining a shellability obstruction. This is a complete natural finite invariant, not a sampled or arbitrary parameter slice.
